title.en: Mangione lawyers to meet federal prosecutors amid reports of plea deal
title.zh: 曼吉奥内律师将在认罪协议报道中会见联邦检察官

summary.en: Mangione faces two federal charges of stalking resulting in death, each carrying a maximum sentence of life in prison.
summary.zh: 这是一则来自全球栏目的新闻，重点涉及公义、尊严与问责。如需完整细节，请阅读英文原始报道。

body.en:
Attorneys for Luigi Mangione, who is accused of killing United Healthcare CEO Brian Thompson in New York, are meeting federal prosecutors on Friday amid US media reports of a potential plea agreement.

Mangione faces two federal charges of stalking resulting in death, each carrying a maximum sentence of life in prison. It was not immediately clear which charges are under discussion.

"There's a conference scheduled for 11 am on Friday, and that's all we can say at this time," Jamie McDonald, the US Attorney for the Southern District of New York (SDNY), said this week.

Mangione also faces a separate state trial over Thompson's death. He has pleaded not guilty to all charges in both cases.

Discussion of a plea deal does not guarantee one will be reached, and such arrangements can fall apart before they are finalised.

Deals must also be approved by the court, and a separate hearing is typically scheduled for the defendant to enter a new plea.

Federal prosecutors brought the stalking charges against Mangione, alleging he travelled between states and carried out electronic surveillance with the intention of killing or harming Thompson. Prosecutors allege those actions resulted in Thompson's death.

A federal judge threw out two other charges in January, including that of murder through use of a firearm, which had carried the possibility of the death penalty.

Mangione's attorneys, the SDNY, and Manhattan District Attorney's office did not respond to the BBC's request for comment.

His attorneys have previously argued he should not be tried in both state and federal court. At the moment, the judges presiding over both cases have allowed the trials to proceed.

But if Mangione pleads guilty in his federal case, it could open the door for his attorneys to argue the state case runs afoul of double jeopardy – a constitutional protection that prevents an individual from being prosecuted twice for the same crime.

New York's state constitution has its own prohibition on double jeopardy, which, if invoked here, could have a knock-on effect on Mangione's upcoming state trial.

"If a federal prosecution has been completed on a matter, the state cannot prosecute the matter on those same facts," said Mitchell Epner, a white-collar attorney.

There is still little clarity on what happens to the state case in that scenario.

Mark Chutkow, a white-collar defence attorney at the Dkyema law firm, says it is "kind of a live issue".

He says the judge in the state trial would have to determine whether the charges overlap enough to trigger New York's double jeopardy statute, while Manhattan prosecutors may argue their case is distinct enough to proceed.

Mangione's state trial is scheduled to begin on 8 September, while the federal trial is listed for January 2027.
body.zh: 被指控在纽约杀害联合医疗保健公司首席执行官布莱恩·汤普森的路易吉·曼吉奥内 (Luigi Mangione) 的律师将于周五与联邦检察官会面，美国媒体报道称可能达成认罪协议。 曼吉奥内面临两项跟踪导致死亡的联邦指控，每项最高可判处终身监禁。目前尚不清楚哪些指控正在讨论中。 纽约南区 (SDNY) 美国检察官杰米·麦克唐纳 (Jamie McDonald) 本周表示：“周五上午 11 点将召开一次会议，目前我们只能说这些。” 曼吉奥内还因汤普森之死而面临单独的州审判。他对这两起案件的所有指控均表示不认罪。 对认罪协议的讨论并不能保证一定能达成认罪协议，而且此类安排可能会在最终敲定之前破裂。 交易还必须得到法院的批准，并且通常会安排单独的听证会，以便被告提出新的抗辩。 联邦检察官对曼吉奥内提出跟踪指控，指控他在各州之间旅行并进行电子监视，意图杀死或伤害汤普森。检察官声称这些行为导致了汤普森的死亡。 一名联邦法官在一月份驳回了另外两项指控，其中包括使用枪支谋杀罪，该罪名有可能被判处死刑。 Mangione 的律师、纽约市警察局和曼哈顿地区检察官办公室没有回应 BBC 的置评请求。 他的律师此前曾辩称，他不应同时在州法院和联邦法院受审。目前，主审两起案件的法官已允许审判继续进行。 但如果曼吉奥内在联邦案件中认罪，他的律师可能会辩称该州案件触犯双重危险——这是一项宪法保护，防止个人因同一罪行而受到两次起诉。 纽约州宪法本身也禁止双重危险，如果在此援引该禁令，可能会对曼吉奥内即将进行的州审判产生连锁反应。 白领律师米切尔·埃普纳 (Mitchell Epner) 表示：“如果联邦对某件事的起诉已经完成，州政府就不能以同样的事实起诉此事。” 在这种情况下，州案件会发生什么，目前还不清楚。 Dkyema 律师事务所的白领辩护律师马克·查特科 (Mark Chutkow) 表示，这是“一个现实问题”。 他说，州审判中的法官必须确定这些指控是否重叠，足以触发纽约的双重危险法规，而曼哈顿检察官可能会辩称，他们的案件足够明确，可以继续审理。 Mangione 的州审判定于 9 月 8 日开始，联邦审判则定于 2027 年 1 月开始。

summary.en: Thousands of sailors on the USS Abraham Lincoln have reportedly faced food shortages and broken plumbing, with some considering jumping overboard.

body.en:
Thousands of US military members who have been living aboard an aircraft carrier for more than 250 days are reportedly contending with food shortages, broken plumbing, exhaustion, and other hardships, leading a lawmaker to demand answers from the Pentagon and putting pressure on the Trump administration over the Iran war.

Military news outlets reported multiple sailors on the USS Abraham Lincoln have considered jumping overboard, as well.

Defence Secretary Pete Hegseth on Thursday called reports of poor conditions "completely misrepresented".

The carrier left California in November for the South China Sea and was sent to the Middle East ahead of attacks on Iran in February.

The deployment, which was originally set to end in May, has been repeatedly extended. No return date has been announced, but on Thursday multiple outlets reported the US is preparing to replace the carrier with the USS George Washington as part of a previously scheduled rotation plan.

Connecticut Senator Richard Blumenthal listed the reported hardships on the carrier, where about 5,000 people are on board, in a letter to Hegseth: "Shortages of basic supplies, water contamination, plumbing issues, deteriorating mental health, deck safety concerns, and disruptions in the mail system, which have caused many care packages in route to the ship to be lost in transit for months."

"These reports warrant immediate attention," the Democrat , who serves on the Armed Services Committee, wrote, "but they also raise a broader question: whether the Navy can sustain the operational tempo now being demanded of its carrier force."

Citing two unnamed officials, CBS News, the BBC's US partner, reported that earlier this month a sailor went overboard and was recovered by a helicopter, treated by the medical department, and transferred off the ship for further care.

The Military Times and Stars and Stripes reported earlier this week that multiple service members had considered suicide by jumping overboard, according to their families. They said that being at sea for an extended period of time and the conditions on board were hurting some members' mental health.

Following those reports, a Navy official told the BBC they had not identified an increase in reported suicidal ideation or suicide attempts aboard the ship and that "traditional supply hubs" had been "disrupted by combat actions".

The Navy was currently putting a priority on delivering "mission-critical supplies" to the ship.

"First food, then hygiene items, then mail," the official said on Wednesday. "Current reports from the ship confirm continuous access to clean water, functional AC (air conditioning), and healthy meal options."

summary.en: About 60 crew responding to blaze covering about 40 acres near Stourbridge golf course Several homes are ablaze and two people are receiving treatment as firefighters attempt to contain a grassfire in the West Midlands. The region’s fire service was alerted to an extensive...
summary.zh: 这是一则来自全球栏目的新闻，重点涉及和平与克制。如需完整细节，请阅读英文原始报道。

body.en:
Several homes are ablaze and two people are receiving treatment as firefighters attempt to contain a grassfire in the West Midlands .

The region’s fire service was alerted to an extensive grassfire near Stourbridge golf course just before 1.30pm on Thursday.

“Some local rail services have been stopped for safety reasons,” a fire service spokesperson said.

Images released by the fire service show the fire spreading into nearby woodland and homes.

The fire service spokesperson said two people had been affected by heat and smoke, but did not give details about their condition.

Six homes were directly affected by the blaze, and others in the area reported power issues.

“Transport is also being arranged for those who can’t make their own way,” West Midlands fire service said in a social media post.

“If you must drive, take extra care if you are driving, avoid areas of dense smoke and please don’t head to areas where fires are taking place to watch.”

Care-home residents have also been evacuated as a result of the fire, the local councillor Andrew Southall said.

The UK recorded its hottest day of the year on Thursday , with the Met Office giving a provisional reading of 38.1C (100.6F) at Kew Gardens in west London.

Forty locations across central and southern England recorded temperatures of 36C or higher.

title.en: When the earth moves: six major earthquakes of 2026
title.zh: 当地球移动时：2026年六次大地震

summary.en: Colombia, Venezuela, Mindanao: Thousands have died in powerful earthquakes this year. Six such events show that the magnitude of the quake is not the only factor determining the scale of the disaster.
summary.zh: 这是一则来自全球栏目的新闻，重点涉及对脆弱群体的怜悯。如需完整细节，请阅读英文原始报道。

body.en:
Colombia, Venezuela, Mindanao: Thousands have died in powerful earthquakes this year. Six such events show that the magnitude of the quake is not the only factor determining the scale of the disaster.

Is 2026 a particularly bad year for earthquakes ? The number of extremely strong quakes so far this year is not, in fact, unusual. Over the long term, around the world, there are an average of about 15 earthquakes per year registering above magnitude 7 on the Richter scale. By mid-August this year, there had been 10. The devastation some of the quakes have wreaked has, however, been striking.

On June 24, Venezuela was hit by an earthquake that proved to be by far the deadliest this year. A magnitude 7.2 quake was followed just 39 seconds later by an even stronger one of magnitude 7.5. The north of the country and the capital, Caracas, were the areas worst affected.

According to official figures, more than 6,300 people were killed in the double earthquake. The effects on the impoverished country's infrastructure have also been dramatic. Shortly afterward, a satellite-based assessment by researchers at Oregon State University provisionally concluded that more than 58,000 buildings may have been damaged or destroyed.

With a magnitude of 7.8, the earthquake on June 8 off the southern coast of the Philippine island of Mindanao was the strongest of 2026 so far. It occurred at a depth of about 57 kilometers (35 miles), and was felt across large parts of the island.

At least 107 people were killed. But the fact that, despite the very high magnitude of the quake, far fewer people died in the Philippines than in Venezuela demonstrates that the strength of the quake does not necessarily determine the severity of the consequences.

On August 10, a magnitude 7.4 earthquake shook western Colombia . The epicenter was in the Choco region, near San Jose del Palmar. Although the quake occurred at a depth of 100 kilometers (62 miles), the damage it caused was immense.

More than 250 people are currently estimated to have died. Landslides and damaged roads are hampering the search for victims buried beneath the rubble, as well as the provision of supplies to remote areas. After Venezuela, this quake is the most consequential so far this year for Latin America.

On March 24, the earth shook near the island group of Vava'u in the Pacific kingdom of Tonga . With a magnitude of 7.5, it was one of the strongest globally this year. But because there was no severe damage and no deaths, it received almost no attention from the media.

The quake occurred unusually far below the earth's crust, at a depth of around 230 kilometers (143 miles), meaning that the tremors were significantly weakened by the time they reached the surface. To date, there have been no reports of deaths,...

title.en: Air India to test all pilots for banned substances
title.zh: 印度航空公司将对所有飞行员进行违禁物质检测

summary.en: Air India announced it will implement mandatory drug testing for all its pilots. This decision follows an incident last week where one of its planes unexpectedly lost altitude, resulting in injuries to several passengers.
summary.zh: 印度航空公司宣布将对其所有飞行员进行强制性药物检测。此举是在上周该公司一架飞机突然失去高度，导致多名乘客受伤的事件之后做出的。

body.en:
Air India is to test all of its pilots for banned substances, starting immediately.

It comes after an incident last week in which its Phuket to Delhi flight suddenly lost altitude, with a preliminary report saying the senior pilot had to retake their substance test. Reports say they had tested positive for marijuana.

Pilots at the airline's budget arm, Air India Express, will also be subject to the tests from Thursday.

Seventeen passengers and crew were injured when the Airbus lost about 91 metres (300 feet) in height shortly after departure on 4 August.

It is being investigated by Indian authorities working alongside Airbus and France's air safety agency.

Both pilots of the flight have been removed from duties until the investigation is complete.

In a memo seen by the BBC, Air India said it was "important to go further" in its testing.

"This initiative, which goes beyond regulatory requirements, reflects our determination to uphold the highest standards of safety and professionalism, and to provide reassurance to our passengers, stakeholders and the community at large," it said.

The airline has already been under scrutiny after a June 2025 flight from Ahmedabad to London crashed shortly after take-off, killing 241 people on board and 19 on the ground. Only one passenger survived.

The tests - for substances as well as medications prohibited under aviation regulations - are being carried out alongside training sessions at Air India's academy, as well as other locations including briefing centres and offices.

Last week, former Ethiopian Airlines boss Tewolde Gebremariam became Air India's new chief executive.
body.zh: 印度航空将立即开始对所有飞行员进行违禁物质检测。 此前，上周普吉岛飞往德里的航班突然失去高度，初步报告称高级飞行员不得不重新接受物质测试。报道称，他们的大麻检测结果呈阳性。 该航空公司廉价部门印度航空快运的飞行员也将从周四开始接受测试。 8 月 4 日，空客飞机起飞后不久高度下降约 91 米（300 英尺），导致 17 名乘客和机组人员受伤。 印度当局正在与空中客车公司和法国航空安全机构合作调查此事。 该航班的两名飞行员均已被停职，直至调查完成。 在英国广播公司看到的一份备忘录中，印度航空表示，在测试中“走得更远很重要”。 该公司表示：“这一举措超出了监管要求，反映了我们维护最高安全和专业标准的决心，并为我们的乘客、利益相关者和整个社区提供保证。” 2025 年 6 月，一架从艾哈迈达巴德飞往伦敦的航班在起飞后不久坠毁，造成机上 241 人和地面 19 人死亡，该航空公司已经受到审查。只有一名乘客幸存。 这些针对航空法规禁止的物质和药物的测试是在印度航空学院以及简报中心和办公室等其他地点的培训课程的同时进行的。 上周，前埃塞俄比亚航空公司老板特沃尔德·格布雷马里亚姆（Tewolde Gebremariam）成为印度航空公司的新任首席执行官。

reflection.en: The incident involving an Air India flight underscores the profound trust placed in those responsible for public safety. Yahweh's word reminds us that faithfulness in seemingly small duties is foundational, as integrity in critical roles ensures the well-being of many. This new policy reflects a commitment to upholding that trust and safeguarding passengers.

title.en: Palestinians told to leave homes in village where Israeli settlers besieged houses
title.zh: 巴勒斯坦人在定居者围困的村庄被告知离开家园

summary.en: The mayor of Qusra, a Palestinian village, reports that Israeli troops have been instructing families to vacate their homes, with some residences subsequently being used as barracks.
summary.zh: 巴勒斯坦村庄库斯拉的市长报告称，以色列军队一直在命令当地家庭撤离家园，一些房屋随后被用作军营。

body.en:
About a dozen Palestinian households in a village in the occupied West Bank were told to leave their properties during an Israeli military operation to remove Israeli settlers.

The settlers had besieged residents in three homes in the area since Sunday, cutting off their power and water supplies.

Qusra Mayor, Abdel Azim Wadi, told the BBC that his village had been declared a closed military zone - and Israeli forces were using some of the vacated Palestinian houses as barracks. The Israeli military said the aim was "to protect the residents".

An Israeli spokesman told the BBC the settlers' action was "deplorable" and "unacceptable" and the government would investigate and arrest those responsible.

"The Israeli army is acting against it, and we are investigating it and we will arrest those responsible and we will prosecute them," David Mencer said.

Settlers have been emboldened by the rapid expansion of settlements under the current Israeli government – leading to a dramatic rise in settler violence as they try to drive Palestinians off their land.

Of the besieged families' three homes in Qusra, which are made up of the Abu Ridi and Hassan families, the residents of two were told to leave on Thursday, they told the BBC. They said those told to leave had since moved into the third house.

Elsewhere in the village, the residents of 11 other houses had also been told to leave by the army.

One of those was Qaher Odeh, who said more than 20 soldiers had entered his house in the morning. They later left but then came back, telling him and his brother they were in a military post and that they needed to leave.

"We left and kept walking down towards the lower part of the neighbourhood. Shortly afterwards, they sealed off the entire area," Odeh said.

Earlier, videos shared from Qusra overnight into Thursday showed a dozen Israeli security vehicles – including a bulldozer.

In later footage – filmed in the daylight – there was a long line of Israeli security forces on the road to the Palestinian village.

The Israel Defense Forces (IDF) said they had "dismantled two illegal outposts".

It added that it had detained one Israeli and confiscated equipment on the outskirts of the Qusra and Jalud areas, near Nablus.

Qusay Abu Ridi, one of the trapped Palestinian family members, told the BBC that the house had been attacked again overnight and that a few settlers had remained in the area, hiding from the army.

His brother – who owns the property – is a Palestinian-American businessman who had complained to the US embassy.

The US Ambassador Mike Huckabee – a longstanding supporter of settlements – called the settler intimidation of the Qusra families "a horrific act of terror.

title.en: Romania shuts only nuclear plant as heat causes huge drop in Danube River level
title.zh: 高温导致多瑙河水位大幅下降，罗马尼亚仅关闭核电站

summary.en: The Cernavodă plant, which produces 20% of Romania's electricity, is not expected to be restarted within the next 10 days.
summary.zh: 这是一则来自全球栏目的新闻，重点涉及和平与克制。如需完整细节，请阅读英文原始报道。

body.en:
Romania has shut down its only nuclear power station because of extremely low water levels in the Danube river caused by prolonged hot weather affecting much of Europe.

The Cernavodă plant, where two reactors produce about 20% of Romania's electricity, is not expected to be restarted within the next 10 days.

Earlier this week, authorities tried to increase the water flow to the plant - which uses the Danube for cooling - by sinking barges loaded with rocks in the river.

Neighbouring Hungary has so far avoided a shutdown of its only nuclear plant in Paks, which also uses the Danube. The waters in Europe's second-longest river have fallen to the lowest levels for 30 years in several countries.

The second of the two 706-megawatt reactors at Cernavodă was disconnected from the Romanian electricity grid just before midday on Thursday.

"We do not foresee a restart within the next 10 days," plant director Romeo Urjan told the AFP news agency.

The shortfall in power is usually covered by solar and wind during the hot, windy daytimes - but traditional coal- and gas-powered generation will have to be supplemented by imports during the evenings.

Romania also has huge hydropower capacity, although that has been heavily cut by the same low river levels that caused the nuclear shutdown.

In Hungary, Prime Minister Péter Magyar warned last month that the Soviet-era Paks, which has four nuclear reactors, could be forced to shut down entirely for the first time.

Plant officials said that levels in the Danube were so low that the suction nozzles used to take in water could not reach it.

Climate change is driving up temperatures around the world - but particularly in Europe.

It is the fasting warming continent, heating up twice as fast as the global average, according to the Copernicus climate service.

This is causing increased summer heatwaves, greater pressure on Europe's waters and more intense wildfires.

The Rhine - another of Europe's key waterway - is also suffering low water levels, which is severely limiting traffic.

Italy's largest agricultural trade association, Coldiretti, said climate-related damage - such as hail, drought and wildfires could exceed €3bn (£2.6bn; $3.5bn).

France's Environment Minister Monique Barbut warned that data from the country's national statistics agency suggested the recent heatwaves could rack up €10bn to €15bn in direct and indirect costs.

The Dutch bank Triodos said the extreme heat and its consequences could wipe out much of the projected economic growth for the EU.

title.zh: 定居者围攻约旦河西岸三处房屋，以色列军队采取行动

summary.en: Israel's military has moved to try to stop a group of settlers from besieging three homes in the occupied West Bank. One was owned by a Palestinian American, prompting an unusually sharp rebuke from the US ambassador.
summary.zh: 这是一则来自全球栏目的新闻，重点涉及和平与克制。如需完整细节，请阅读英文原始报道。

body.zh: 以色列军方已采取行动，试图阻止一群定居者围攻被占领的约旦河西岸的三座房屋。其中一辆的主人是一名巴勒斯坦裔美国人，这引起了美国大使异常尖锐的谴责。 以色列已派出士兵试图保护被占领的约旦河西岸库斯拉村的三座房屋，这些房屋几天来一直被一小群以色列定居者包围。 三栋房屋中的一栋由一名巴勒斯坦美国人拥有，这一事件引起了美国驻以色列大使迈克·哈卡比（Mike Huckabee）的异常批评回应，他通常被认为是以色列定居者运动的盟友。 此案发生之际，以色列在被占领的约旦河西岸部分地区继续修建定居点，根据国际法被认为是非法的，以色列政府的批评者指控以色列政府有时对定居者针对巴勒斯坦人的暴力行为视而不见，或采取的措施太少。 从周日开始，一群定居者开始聚集在库斯拉村的三栋房屋周围。 其中一栋建筑属于巴勒斯坦裔美国房主路易·里迪 (Loui Ridi)。当地官员称，定居者有时有数十人。据称，他们投掷石块，试图推倒石墙，并阻止居住者在物资减少时离开家园。 里迪的兄弟库赛·阿布·里达（Qusai Abu Rida）与儿子一起躲在房子里，周四早上表示，他们已被以色列军方转移到另一个家，但仍然无法离开距离巴勒斯坦城市纳布卢斯约 16 公里（10 英里）的地区。路易·里迪 (Loui Ridi) 居住在俄亥俄州，但拥有该房产。 以色列国防军军方表示，其部队拆除了房屋附近的“两个非法哨所”，并拘留了一名以色列人。目前尚不清楚此人是否受到逮捕或调查，或者只是被拘留。 当地市长阿卜杜勒·阿齐姆·瓦迪表示，以色列军队从家中疏散了七户巴勒斯坦家庭，为士兵在村里占据阵地腾出空间。他说，尽管定居者被从前哨基地转移，但他们仍然留在村庄的其他地方。 美联社援引邻近村庄居民亚西尔·艾哈迈德 (Yasser Ahmad) 的话说：“任何人都不允许进入。甚至连食物和水也被禁止送给被围困的人。”他在一座山顶上观看了行动的展开。 库斯拉位于西岸北部最暴力的地区之一，周围都是定居点。其清真寺在上个月的袭击中遭到破坏。 美国驻以色列大使迈克·哈卡比（Mike Huckabee）通常是以色列定居者运动的支持者，但也批评定居者的暴力行为，他以异常尖锐的措辞反对影响美国的事件……

summary.en: Amid growing tensions and security risks in the Horn of Africa, Eritrea, with its strategically important coastal points on the Red Sea, is emerging as an important player in the region.

body.en:
Amid growing tensions and security risks in the Horn of Africa, Eritrea, with its strategically important coastal points on the Red Sea, is emerging as an important player in the region.

Across the Horn of Africa , geopolitical interests of various countries continue to cause tensions and conflict as part of the growing competition for political influence over the region.

In its own right, the small country of  Eritrea  appears to be gaining in importance within this context: The autocratic state run by long-standing ruler  Isaias Afwerki  controls strategically important coastal points on the Red Sea, especially with its ports of Assab and Massawa.

In July, a series of diplomatic consultations in Cairo involving regional powers like Egypt,  Somalia , Eritrea, and a high-ranking US envoy highlighted Eritrea's growing role in helping to coordinate approaches to resolving serious security challenges in the Horn of Africa and the Red Sea, and to facilitate trade.

Eritrea's unique location along this maritime route is notably becoming more and more strategic in light of international trade conflicts. The small nation's coastline near the Bab-al-Mandab Strait stretches for more than 1,000 kilometers (621.4 miles), bordering Sudan to the northwest and Djibouti to the southeast.

But Eritrea's main strategic importance relies on who is on the other side of the strait, which at its narrowest point measures less than 30 kilometers.

"Yemen lies on the other side of the Red Sea , which makes Eritrea's location particularly interesting, as Yemen is in a state of crisis and maritime security in the region is at risk," Abdurahman Sayed, director of the Horn of Africa Centre for Regional Integration (CRI) in London, told DW.

"The only safe route in this area runs through Eritrea, where there are currently no security concerns."

The Houthi militia , propped up by Iran, have been attacking merchant ships in the Red Sea from the Yemeni coastline.

For the past ten years,  Yemen has also been witnessing one of the world's worst humanitarian crises in its midst: Ongoing violence, economic collapse, droughts and floods have exacerbated the suffering in the country, according to a report published by the UN Refugee Agency last month.

Sayed meanwhile emphasizes that in Eritrea, the strong dictatorship entrenched for decades does not tolerate any type of dissent. In many international freedom indexes, the African nation often only comes second to North Korea.

Since the country was officially founded 32 years ago, there have been no elections in the one-party state under long-time ruler Afwerki.

title.en: What would a North Korean troop surge mean for Ukraine war?
title.zh: 朝鲜增兵对乌克兰战争意味着什么？

summary.en: Ukraine is claiming that North Korea is preparing to send tens of thousands more troops to Russia, where they'll gain valuable battlefield experience.
summary.zh: 这是一则来自全球栏目的新闻，重点涉及和平与克制。如需完整细节，请阅读英文原始报道。

body.en:
Ukraine is claiming that North Korea is preparing to send tens of thousands more troops to Russia, where they'll gain valuable battlefield experience.

North Korea is preparing a massive troop surge to help its ally Moscow in its war on Ukraine , with up to 50,000 North Koreans to be deployed in Russia , according to Ukrainian President Volodymyr Zelenskyy .

In late July, the Ukrainian leader said Russia wanted to bring in another 30,000 North Korean troops, before adding this weekend that Pyongyang decided to have between 30,000 and 50,000 North Koreans deployed on Russian territory. He did not specify if this number included the North Korean troops already taking part in the conflict.

In the comments published this weekend, Zelenskyy also warned North Korea was gaining valuable experience in modern warfare and urged South Korea to boost cooperation with Ukraine on air defense and drones. Two days later, Zelenskyy said Russia had received more North Korean ballistic missiles, which were allegedly used in an attack on Zaporizhzhia.

Russia and North Korea signed a defense pact in the summer of 2024, with North Korea starting to send combat troops to Russia several months later . Analysts believe some 14,000 to 15,000 personnel were deployed, mainly in the Kursk region.

Pyongyang later agreed to send another 6,000 sappers and military construction workers. North Korea has also supplied Russia with millions of artillery rounds and ballistic missiles, according to South Korean and Ukrainian authorities. South Korean intelligence estimates that around 6,000 North Korean soldiers have been killed or wounded.

On Thursday, Japan's Kyodo News cited Ukrainian military intelligence as confirming the upcoming North Korean surge. Ukrainian sources say up to 50,000 North Korean troops could be deployed to Russia by the end of November; The troops would reportedly take over duties in Russia's Kursk, Bryansk and Belgorod, freeing Russian forces for the Ukrainian front.

South Korean lawmaker Yu Yong-weon told DW the military cooperation between Russia and Korea was growing ever closer.

Yu is a former military journalist who visited Ukraine in 2025 and again in February this year. He said he heard claims of the North Korean surge during his most recent visit to the war-torn country.

Yu noted that 30,000 to 50,000 troops would be significantly more than the roughly 20,000 troops and support forces involved in the initial deployment.

"Whether such a large-scale additional troop deployment will actually take place," Yu said, "the continued expansion of military cooperation between Pyongyang and Moscow called closer attention from the South Korean government and military."

title.en: Trump's fiercest defender? Five moments defining Karoline Leavitt's time as press secretary
title.zh: 特朗普最坚定的捍卫者？定义卡罗琳·莱维特新闻秘书生涯的五个时刻

summary.en: Karoline Leavitt has been a highly visible and loyal figure within the Trump administration, known for her role as a press secretary.
summary.zh: 卡罗琳·莱维特在特朗普政府中一直是一位备受瞩目且忠诚的人物，以其新闻秘书的角色而闻名。

body.en:
Karoline Leavitt is leaving her post as White House press secretary after 20 months marked by fierce loyalty to United States President Donald Trump and fiery clashes with the media.

As Trump's highest-ranking spokesperson, the 28-year-old became known for her unwavering defences of the president, her embrace of MAGA and "new media" voices including podcasters and influencers, and her amplification of false, misleading and highly contentious claims from the podium.

Trump announced she was leaving her role at the end of the month to spend more time with her family, and would continue to serve as one of his "top outside advisors, and an influential voice within the Republican Party". Leavitt has two young children, the first born during Trump's 2024 presidential campaign and the second in May this year.

She was the first White House press secretary history to give birth while serving in the role, and the youngest person ever to hold the position.

Leavitt has been press secretary since Trump returned to office in January last year, making her the president's second-longest-serving press secretary after Sarah Huckabee Sanders, who served from 2017 to 2019.

Your trusted source for staying up-to-date with the world around you. Get free daily news updates and analysis, straight to your inbox.

Trump's next press secretary will be his sixth across two terms. He is yet to indicate who may replace Leavitt.

Leavitt and White House communications director Steven Cheung revamped the Trump administration's already-confrontational posture toward the media.

The Trump administration began handpicking which journalists would receive access to the president, overhauling the long-running system established by the independent White House Correspondents Association.

The "press pool" was traditionally a rotation chosen by the industry group to ensure media outlets had uniform access to the president and could relay his activities to the public and to other journalists who could not attend smaller gatherings.

In one of Leavitt's first moves as press secretary last year, she introduced a "new media seat" in the White House briefing room. Continuing Trump's longstanding attacks on establishment journalists, she vowed to give new media voices a more prominent role in covering his presidency.

"We welcome independent journalists, podcasters, social media influencers and content creators to apply for credentials to cover this White House," she said in January 2025.

body.en:
Eurovision Song Contest organisers announced overnight they were excluding any country involved in an armed conflict from hosting the competition and increased the minimum age of competitors.

While they did not mention any country by name, Israel, which has been at war in Gaza since 2023 , came close to winning the competition in both 2025 and 2026, ultimately finishing second on each occasion.

Under the old rules, the winning country normally hosts the following year's competition.

Under the new rules, "the winning broadcaster will automatically be ineligible to host the contest if an armed conflict, a sensitive geopolitical situation, or any other situation materially affects the security, safety or stability of their state or immediate region", the organisers said in a statement.

In a first, five countries — Spain, Ireland, the Netherlands, Slovenia and Iceland — boycotted the 2026 competition in Vienna over Israel's participation.

They said they could not take part alongside Israel because of its war in Gaza .

A United Nations Independent International Commission of Inquiry (COI), which does not speak on behalf of the UN as a whole and has been criticised by Israel, concluded in September 2025 that Israel is committing genocide in Gaza.

Israel is separately defending a genocide case at the International Court of Justice (ICJ), which has ordered Israel to implement provisional measures to ensure genocidal actions are not committed in Gaza, but has yet to issue a final ruling.

Martin Green, director of the Eurovision Song Contest, said in a statement that the changes had been guided by feedback from member countries.

He added: "These changes are about giving everyone involved greater clarity, protecting artists and ensuring the contest continues to provide a safe and welcoming environment, while preserving the spirit and integrity that make the Eurovision Song Contest so special."

The organisers also announced that competitors must be at least 18, up from 16, on the day of their first rehearsal.

"This change continues the work already undertaken by the contest to strengthen safeguarding and protect younger artists from the pressures associated with competing at the Eurovision Song Contest," they added in the statement.

The youngest person to win the contest was 13-year-old Sandra Kim from Belgium in 1986, according to Eurovision records.

Eurovision is a co-production of public broadcasters belonging to the European Broadcasting Union. Since the EBU includes members from outside Europe, the contest is not limited to European countries.

body.en:
The Israeli military said overnight it would deploy additional troops to restore order after failing to end a blockade by Israeli settlers of Palestinian homes in the occupied West Bank.

The siege began on Sunday, when settlers erected a makeshift tent near homes in the Palestinian village of Qusra, south of Nablus, preventing essential food and medical supplies from reaching residents.

Israeli troops clashed with the settlers while trying to disperse them from the outpost they set up directly in front of Palestinian homes, according to witnesses.

The incident marked a rare confrontation between settlers and the military and comes amid a sharp increase in settler land seizures and attacks on Palestinians.

All Israeli settlements and outposts in the occupied West Bank are illegal under international law.

"We have received no food and no medicine," Qusai Abu Rida, a Palestinian trapped inside one of the houses, told the Agence France-Presse (AFP) news agency by telephone, adding that he had only managed to secure electricity thanks to solar panels.

The Israeli military condemned the settlers' actions and declared the area a "closed military zone", removing their tent on Wednesday morning (local time).

By mid-afternoon, an AFP photographer at the scene said the military had left and the tent had been removed, but the settlers were still there.

"The army has withdrawn, and so far we are still besieged, with the settlers at our doorstep," he said.

Later on Wednesday, the military announced it would send an additional infantry battalion and that more soldiers would be on standby.

The chief of the general staff "directed that efforts to strengthen order and operational control in the area continue, as well as efforts to prevent further serious incidents", a military statement said.

A day earlier, the Israeli military said it had received reports of settlers entering and taking control of Palestinian homes and land in the area.

"This is illegal, reprehensible and unacceptable activity that harms the residents of the areas and disrupts their daily lives," it said.

It also said that disciplinary action would be taken against security personnel who had been filmed at the site days earlier.

Violence by Israeli settlers towards Palestinians in the West Bank has persisted for years , often with little or no legal consequence, but recent months have seen a surge in attacks .

Last Sunday, Israel's military closed the West Bank village of Taybeh to non-residents to prevent growing attacks on Palestinians by Israeli settlers. Taybeh is one of the only Christian villages remaining in the West Bank.

body.en:
White House press secretary Karoline Leavitt, who earned a reputation for acid putdowns of journalists, is to step down, United States President Donald Trump announced on Thursday AEST, adding she would remain a senior adviser.

Leavitt, 28, the youngest-ever US presidential spokesperson, has been a fiercely loyal Trump defender, delivering fluent and aggressive performances at often combative press briefings.

"Our wonderful White House Press Secretary, and one of my most trusted aides , Karoline Leavitt, will be departing her role at the end of the month so she can spend more time with her beautiful young children and family," Trump said on social media.

"Karoline will now be one of my top outside advisors, and an influential voice within the Republican Party."

In May, Leavitt announced the birth of her second child — a girl named Viviana — just days after delaying her maternity leave following an alleged assassination attempt on Trump when a gunman tried to storm the White House Correspondents' Dinner .

Her departure comes as Trump faces steadily sinking poll numbers and the Republican Party risks defeat in the November midterm congressional elections.

"I am thankful to the President for entrusting me with the distinct privilege of speaking on his behalf at the White House podium," Leavitt said on social media as her departure was announced.

"I have relished holding the liberal media accountable and ensuring the American people hear the truth about President Trump’s successes."

Leavitt wrote that, after returning to the White House following the birth of her daughter, "I have felt in my heart that I cannot be the best mom my two young children deserve" while devoting the attention needed as press secretary.

Leavitt is a Trump veteran who served in his press office during his first term that ended in 2021 and then as his spokesperson during his 2024 election campaign.

Leavitt's tenure as press secretary saw a revival of regular briefings that had petered out during the first term, but she presided over a sea change in White House interactions with journalists.

In February 2025, she stunned the press corps when she announced that the White House itself — and not an independent association of correspondents — would choose which reporters got to cover Trump up close in the Oval Office and on Air Force One.

She also facilitated press credentials from right-wing, pro-Trump media outlets, diluting the presence of traditional news media that tend to ask more challenging questions in the briefing room.

summary.en: Meaningful diplomacy on an international level is well overdue, writes Jennifer Hubbard. Plus letters from Geoffrey Dixon and Jane Renton In his article on China’s latest tool for suppression of minorities, the “ethnic unity” law, Simon Tisdall seems to take it as read that...
summary.zh: 这是一则来自中国栏目的新闻，重点涉及公义、尊严与问责。如需完整细节，请阅读英文原始报道。

body.en: Meaningful diplomacy on an international level is well overdue, writes Jennifer Hubbard . Plus letters from Geoffrey Dixon and Jane Renton In his article on China’s latest tool for suppression of minorities, the “ethnic unity” law, Simon Tisdall seems to take it as read that western governments will continue to pay lip service to notions of human rights in China while pursuing short-term economic goals, ultimately destructive to their own productivity ( President Xi never wastes a good crisis. As Iran, Ukraine and Palestine distract the world, he tightens his grip, 8 August ). This has been the pattern since June 1989, the Tiananmen Square massacre. His faint hope that the young urban Chinese might overturn Xi’s regime is a judgment on the failure of western governments to show any foresight, integrity, effective diplomacy, joined-up thinking or action. They rely on the self-sacrifice of individuals such as Jimmy Lai , Lobga Rangzen and countless – often to us nameless – individuals who put their lives on the line while we wring our hands and weep crocodile tears. Continue reading...
body.zh: 詹妮弗·哈伯德写道，早就应该在国际层面开展有意义的外交。再加上杰弗里·迪克森和简·伦顿的来信。西蒙·蒂斯达尔在其关于中国镇压少数民族的最新工具“民族团结”法的文章中似乎认为，西方政府将继续对中国的人权观念口头上说好，同时追求短期经济目标，最终损害他们自己的生产力（习主席从来不会浪费一场好的危机。随着伊朗、乌克兰和巴勒斯坦分散了世界的注意力，他加强了控制，8月8日）。自1989年6月天安门广场大屠杀以来，这一直是这种模式。他对中国城市年轻人可能推翻习近平政权的微弱希望是对西方政府未能表现出任何远见、正直、有效外交、联合思维或行动的判断。他们依赖于黎智英（Jimmy Lai）、洛布加·让赞（Lobga Rangzen）等个人的自我牺牲，以及无数（通常对我们来说无名）个人的自我牺牲，他们冒着生命危险，而我们则绞尽脑汁，流下鳄鱼的眼泪。继续阅读...

reflection.en: This story draws attention to justice, dignity, and accountability. Micah 6:8 reminds us to meet sharp headlines with justice tempered by mercy, asking how faithful people can respond with wisdom instead of noise.
reflection.zh: 这则新闻让人想到公义、尊严与问责。Micah 6:8提醒我们，在快速变化的新闻里，仍要以带着怜悯的公义来回应，并学习用祷告与分辨代替情绪化判断。

verse.textEn: What does Yahweh require of you? To act justly and to love mercy and to walk humbly with your God.
verse.textZh: 雅伟向你所要的是什么呢？只要你行公义，好怜悯，存谦卑的心，与你的神同行。

title.en: Taiwan says it was hit by ‘abnormal’ AI-assisted cyber-attack
title.zh: 台湾称遭受“异常”人工智能辅助网络攻击

summary.en: Taiwan reported detecting "abnormal" AI-assisted cyber-attacks on government agencies last month, originating from overseas. These attacks represent a new kind of threat, with suspected links to China-based hackers.
summary.zh: 台湾报告称，上个月侦测到来自海外、由人工智能辅助的“异常”网络攻击，目标是政府机构。这些攻击代表了一种新型威胁，据称与中国相关黑客有关。

body.en: Taiwan’s statement comes a day after reports that suspected China-linked hackers had carried out a first-of-a-kind breach Taiwan says it detected AI-assisted cyber-attacks on government agencies that came from overseas last month, a new kind of threat that has been reported as “first-of-a-kind breach”. The Ministry of Digital Affairs (MDA) said its cybersecurity monitoring units ‌detected the “abnormal attack” targeting government agencies, which began on 20 July. The National Institute of Cyber Security issued a series of warning alerts while it investigated. Continue reading...
body.zh: 台湾发表声明的前一天，有报道称疑似与中国有关的黑客实施了史无前例的违规行为。台湾表示，上个月检测到来自海外的针对政府机构的人工智能辅助网络攻击，这是一种新的威胁，被报道为“史无前例的违规行为”。数字事务部 (MDA) 表示，其网络安全监控单位检测到 7 月 20 日开始的针对政府机构的“异常攻击”。美国国家网络安全研究所在调查过程中发布了一系列警告。继续阅读...

reflection.en: The emergence of AI-assisted cyber-attacks highlights the constant need for vigilance in a rapidly changing world. Proverbs 27:12 reminds us that wisdom lies in foreseeing danger and taking appropriate refuge. As technology evolves, so must our discernment and protective measures, trusting Yahweh for guidance.
reflection.zh: 人工智能辅助的网络攻击的出现，凸显了在快速变化的世界中保持警惕的持续必要性。箴言27:12提醒我们，智慧在于预见危险并采取适当的避难措施。随着科技发展，我们的洞察力和保护措施也必须随之进步，信靠雅伟的指引。

verse.textEn: The prudent see danger and take refuge, but the simple keep going and pay the penalty.
verse.textZh: 通达人见祸藏躲；愚蒙人前往受害。

title.en: With Hollywood struggling in China, can the Odyssey draw a crowd?
title.zh: 好莱坞在中国市场举步维艰，《奥德赛》能否吸引观众？

summary.en: Christopher Nolan's summer blockbuster, "The Odyssey" (likely Oppenheimer), is set for release across China's Imax screens. This comes at a time when Western films generally face difficulties in the Chinese market, and the film itself has reportedly overcome significant opposition.
summary.zh: 克里斯托弗·诺兰的夏季大片《奥德赛》（很可能是《奥本海默》）将在中国各地的IMAX影院上映。目前西方电影在中国市场普遍举步维艰，而这部影片据报道也克服了来自世界首富的猛烈攻击。

body.en: Christopher Nolan’s epic will be released on Friday across most of the country’s 800 Imax screens, at a time when western films have been struggling The Odyssey, Christopher Nolan’s summer blockbuster juggernaut, has overcome an onslaught of attacks from the world’s richest man and stared down criticism from a classicist who translated the poem , to become one of the year’s most celebrated and highest-grossing films. But this week, the film faces one of its biggest challenges yet. Continue reading...
body.zh: 克里斯托弗·诺兰的这部史诗巨制将于周五在全国 800 块 Imax 银幕上上映，当时西方电影一直在苦苦挣扎，克里斯托弗·诺兰的夏季大片《奥德赛》克服了来自世界首富的猛烈攻击，也顶住了翻译这首诗的古典学家的批评，成为今年最著名和票房最高的电影之一。但本周，这部电影面临着迄今为止最大的挑战之一。继续阅读...

reflection.en: Launching any major endeavor, like a film in a challenging market, requires immense effort and hope for success. Proverbs 16:3 reminds us to commit our work to Yahweh, trusting that He will establish our plans. Even when facing significant headwinds, we can find peace in knowing that our diligent efforts are seen and can be blessed.
reflection.zh: 在充满挑战的市场中推出一部电影这样的大型项目，需要付出巨大的努力并寄予成功的希望。箴言16:3提醒我们，要将我们的工作交托给雅伟，相信他会成就我们的计划。即使面对重重阻力，我们也能在知道自己的辛勤努力被看见并蒙福时找到平安。

verse.textEn: Commit to Yahweh whatever you do, and he will establish your plans.
verse.textZh: 你所做的，要交托雅伟，你所谋的，就必成立。

title.en: Zhu Rongji obituary
title.zh: 朱镕基讣告

summary.en: Zhu Rongji, the fifth premier of the People’s Republic of China, has passed away at 97. He was widely recognized as an economic reformer who famously declared China 'the factory of the world' and was regarded as one of the country's most effective administrators.
summary.zh: 中华人民共和国第五任总理朱镕基逝世，享年97岁。他被广泛认为是经济改革家，曾宣布中国成为‘世界工厂’，并被视为该国最有效的管理者之一。

body.en: Premier of the People’s Republic of China regarded as an economic reformer who declared that the country had become ‘the factory of the world’ Zhu Rongji, who has died aged 97, was the fifth premier of the People’s Republic of China and one of its most effective administrators and economic reformers following its foundation in 1949. In 1991, Zhu was summoned to Beijing, in the footsteps of the then president and party secretary Jiang Zemin , and in the aftermath of the 1989 uprisings in Beijing and the collapse of the Soviet Union. Continue reading...
body.zh: 中华人民共和国总理被誉为经济改革家，宣称中国已成为“世界工厂”。 朱镕基去世，享年 97 岁。朱镕基是中华人民共和国第五任总理，也是自 1949 年建国以来最有效的管理者和经济改革家之一。1991 年，朱镕基追随时任国家主席兼党委书记江泽民的脚步，在改革开放之后被召唤到北京。 1989年北京起义和苏联解体。继续阅读...

reflection.en: The passing of a leader like Zhu Rongji marks the end of a significant chapter, reflecting a life dedicated to public service and economic reform. His legacy reminds us that every life is a race run, with efforts and impacts that shape the world around us. Yahweh invites us to consider how we too might finish our own race with integrity and purpose.
reflection.zh: 朱镕基这样一位领导人的逝世，标志着一个重要篇章的结束，反映了他一生致力于公共服务和经济改革。他的遗产提醒我们，每个人的一生都是一场赛跑，其努力和影响塑造着我们周围的世界。雅伟邀请我们思考，我们又将如何以正直和目标跑完自己的赛程。

verse.textEn: I have fought the good fight, I have finished the race, I have kept the faith.
verse.textZh: 那美好的仗我已经打过了，当跑的路我已经跑尽了，所信的道我已经守住了。

title.en: Mass evacuations in Beijing as Typhoon Dolphin brings more torrential rain to China
title.zh: 台风海豚带来更多暴雨，北京大规模疏散

summary.en: Forecasters warned the Chinese capital could receive more than one-third of its average annual rainfall over 24 hours Thousands of people have been evacuated from areas at risk of flooding and landslides in Beijing, as the remnants of Typhoon Dolphin continue to bring torrential...
summary.zh: 预报员警告称，中国首都北京在24小时内可能迎来超过年平均降雨量三分之一的降水。随着台风“海豚”的残余继续带来暴雨，北京数千人已从有洪水和山体滑坡风险的地区撤离。

body.en: Forecasters warned the Chinese capital could receive more than one-third of its average annual rainfall over 24 hours Thousands of people have been evacuated from areas at risk of flooding and landslides in Beijing, as the remnants of Typhoon Dolphin continue to bring torrential rain to northern and central China. Forecasters warned on Tuesday that the Chinese capital could receive more than 150mm of rain over the following 24 hours, with some districts forecast to exceed 200mm – more than one-third of Beijing’s average annual rainfall of 528mm. Continue reading...
body.zh: 预报员警告说，中国首都24小时内的降雨量可能会达到年平均降雨量的三分之一以上。随着台风“海豚”的余波继续给中国北部和中部地区带来暴雨，北京有数千人已从面临洪水和山体滑坡风险的地区撤离。预报员周二警告说，未来24小时内，中国首都的降雨量可能超过150毫米，部分地区预计将超过200毫米——超过北京年平均降雨量528毫米的三分之一。继续阅读...

reflection.en: As Beijing faces torrential rains and evacuations, the immediate need for safety and shelter is paramount. In times of natural disaster, we are reminded that Yahweh is our refuge and strength, a very present help in trouble. Even amidst the chaos, we can find solace and resilience in His unwavering presence.
reflection.zh: 当北京面临暴雨和疏散时，对安全和庇护的即时需求至关重要。在自然灾害面前，我们被提醒雅伟是我们的避难所和力量，是我们在患难中随时的帮助。即使在混乱之中，我们也能在祂坚定不移的同在中找到慰藉和韧性。

verse.textEn: God is our refuge and strength, an ever-present help in trouble.
verse.textZh: 神是我们的避难所，是我们的力量，是我们在患难中随时的帮助。

title.en: Passenger jet billed as China’s answer to Boeing and Airbus prepares to make first international flight
title.zh: 中国客机C919首次国际飞行，旨在挑战波音和空客

summary.en: China's domestically produced Comac C919 passenger jet is set to undertake its first international flight from Beijing to Ulaanbaatar, Mongolia. While this marks a significant step, experts suggest it will take generations for the aircraft to challenge the established dominance of Western manufacturers like Boeing and...
summary.zh: 中国国产的C919客机将首次执飞国际航线，从北京飞往蒙古乌兰巴托。尽管这是重要一步，但专家指出，该机型可能需要数代时间才能挑战波音和空客等西方制造商在商业航空领域的既有主导地位。

body.en: The Comac C919 will fly from Beijing to Ulaanbaatar in Mongolia, although experts say it could take generations for it to challenge the west’s dominance of the industry China hopes to break into the world of commercial aviation with the first international flight of a Chinese-made passenger jet scheduled for Wednesday. The Comac C919 will take off from Beijing capital international airport at 3pm, landing in Ulaanbaatar, the capital of Mongolia, just over two hours later. Continue reading...
body.zh: 中国商飞 C919 将从北京飞往蒙古乌兰巴托，尽管专家表示，它可能需要几代人的时间才能挑战西方在该行业的主导地位。中国希望通过中国制造的客机定于周三进行的首次国际飞行，打入商业航空领域。中国商飞C919飞机将于下午3点从北京首都国际机场起飞，两个多小时后抵达蒙古首都乌兰巴托。继续阅读...

reflection.en: The launch of a new aircraft, aiming to compete globally, represents a significant national endeavor and a long-term vision. As we witness such ambitious human undertakings, Proverbs 16:3 reminds us to commit our plans to Yahweh, trusting that our purposes will then be established. This perspective encourages both diligent effort and humble reliance on...
reflection.zh: 一款新飞机的推出，旨在全球竞争，代表着一项重大的国家努力和长远愿景。当我们看到这样雄心勃勃的人类事业时，箴言16:3提醒我们，要将我们的工作交托给雅伟，相信我们的计划就必坚定。这种视角鼓励我们既要勤奋努力，又要谦卑地依靠雅伟的指引，以取得持久的成功。

verse.textEn: Commit to Yahweh whatever you do, and he will establish your plans.
verse.textZh: 你所做的，要交托雅伟，你所谋的，就必成立。

title.en: Floods, storms and landslides: Typhoon Dolphin ravages China – in pictures
title.zh: 洪水、风暴和山体滑坡：“海豚”台风肆虐中国——图集

summary.en: Typhoon Dolphin, the most powerful tropical cyclone to hit China this year, has caused widespread damage along the country's east coast. It brought strong winds, torrential rain, and severe flooding, with Beijing bracing for a significant portion of its annual rainfall in a single day.
summary.zh: 今年袭击中国的最强热带气旋“海豚”台风给中国东海岸带来了大风、暴雨和洪水，造成了广泛破坏。北京正准备迎接其年降雨量三分之一的雨水在24小时内降临。

reflection.en: The immense power of Typhoon Dolphin reminds us of creation's vulnerability and the deep impact natural forces can have on human lives and infrastructure. In moments when the earth itself seems to groan under the weight of storms, we are called to acknowledge the broader suffering of creation.
reflection.zh: “海豚”台风的巨大威力提醒我们，受造界是脆弱的，自然力量能对人类生活和基础设施造成深远影响。当地球本身似乎在风暴的重压下呻吟时，我们被呼召去认识到受造界更广泛的苦难。

verse.textEn: We know that the whole creation has been groaning as in the pains of childbirth right up to the present time.
verse.textZh: 我们知道，一切受造之物一同叹息、劳苦，直到如今。

title.en: The China factor in the United States' $500 million move in a tiny Australian town
title.zh: 美国在澳大利亚小镇投资5亿美元的“中国因素”

summary.en: The Pentagon is investing $500 million in a small Australian town in New South Wales, a move attributed to strategic considerations related to China. The reason for this sudden interest in a town of only 130 people is its role in broader international geopolitical dynamics.
summary.zh: 五角大楼正在澳大利亚新南威尔士州的一个小镇投资5亿美元，此举被认为是与中国相关的战略考量。这个只有130人的小镇突然受到关注，是因为它在全球地缘政治动态中的作用。

body.en:
The town of Fifield near Parkes is about a six-hour drive west of Sydney, and at the last Census was home to about 130 people. Now, the town has found itself at the centre of a major strategic play by the United States government.

The US Department of War has committed to make a conditional loan of US$400 million (about $566 million) to Sunrise Energy Metals, an Australian mining company hoping to deliver the world’s first supply of a key critical mineral outside of China.

Scandium is listed as a critical mineral in both Australia and the US, signalling its strategic importance in aerospace and defence.

This loan is another chapter in the US government’s search for secure critical mineral supply chains to reduce its dependency on Chinese supply. But success will require sustained investment and government support.

Your trusted source for staying up-to-date with the world around you. Get free daily news updates and analysis, straight to your inbox.

Scandium is a highly strategic metal used to produce ultra-high-strength alloys needed for the most advanced fighter jets. It is also used in solid oxide fuel cells, crucial for providing reliable power to artificial intelligence (AI) data centres.

First, demand for scandium is being driven by massive increases in defence spending across North America, Europe and Asia and an investment boom in power-hungry AI data centres.

Second, China’s sweeping export controls on rare earth elements, including scandium, have contributed to a persistent shortage of supply on the global market, pushing up prices.

These export controls are designed to maintain China’s dominance of supply chains for key critical minerals and slow down the US defence and industrial base.

Still, the market for scandium is tiny. According to statistics from the US Geological Survey, the entire world only consumed 60 tonnes of the metal in 2025.

Scandium is usually found in very small quantities. For that reason, until now, it has been exclusively produced as a byproduct of nickel and titanium processing.

This is what sets the Sunrise Energy Metals project apart — the proposed mine has scandium deposits in a high enough concentration to be the first primary source of scandium in the world.

If production goes ahead, and lives up to its promise of producing 60 tonnes of high-purity scandium each year by 2028, this would be enough to completely satisfy the current level of global demand.

According to the company, there is also potential to expand the project in the future and add another 120 tonnes of production.

The deal gives the US government first rights to purchase scandium from Sunrise Energy Metals, with production expected to start in late 2028.

body.zh: 帕克斯 (Parkes) 附近的菲尔菲尔德 (Fifield) 镇位于悉尼以西约 6 小时车程处，根据上次人口普查，该镇约有 130 人。现在，该镇已成为美国政府一项重大战略行动的中心。 美国陆军部已承诺向澳大利亚矿业公司 Sunrise Energy Metals 提供 4 亿美元（约合 5.66 亿美元）的有条件贷款，该公司希望在中国境外提供全球第一批关键矿物供应。 钪在澳大利亚和美国均被列为重要矿物，表明其在航空航天和国防领域的战略重要性。 这笔贷款是美国政府寻求安全的关键矿产供应链以减少对中国供应依赖的又一篇章。但成功需要持续的投资和政府支持。 您值得信赖的来源，让您了解周围世界的最新动态。直接将免费的每日新闻更新和分析发送到您的收件箱。 钪是一种高度战略性金属，用于生产最先进战斗机所需的超高强度合金。它还用于固体氧化物燃料电池，这对于为人工智能（AI）数据中心提供可靠的电力至关重要。 首先，北美、欧洲和亚洲国防支出的大幅增加以及耗电的人工智能数据中心的投资热潮推动了对钪的需求。 其次，中国对包括钪在内的稀土元素实行全面的出口管制，导致全球市场供应持续短缺，推高价格。 这些出口管制旨在维持中国在关键矿产供应链中的主导地位，并减缓美国国防和工业基础的发展。 尽管如此，钪的市场仍然很小。据美国地质调查局统计，2025年全球仅消耗了60吨金属。 钪的含量通常非常少。因此，到目前为止，它仅作为镍和钛加工的副产品生产。 这就是 Sunrise Energy Metals 项目的与众不同之处——拟建矿山的钪矿床浓度足够高，可以成为世界上第一个主要钪来源。 如果生产继续进行，并兑现到2028年每年生产60吨高纯钪的承诺，这将足以完全满足目前的全球需求水平。 该公司表示，未来还有可能扩大该项目，再增加120吨的产量。 该交易赋予美国政府从 Sunrise Energy Metals 购买钪的优先权，预计将于 2028 年底开始生产。 然而，这样做也存在一些风险……

title.en: Worldview 'gulf' behind strained Australia-China ties, former Australian ambassador says
title.zh: 前澳大利亚大使称，世界观“鸿沟”是澳中关系紧张的幕后原因

summary.en: Australia's former ambassador to China identified "diverging worldviews" as a key obstacle to fostering a robust relationship between the two nations.

body.en:
Australia is unlikely ever to have a true partnership with China due to a mismatch of worldviews, rendering it pointless to pursue that goal, the nation's former top diplomat to China says.

But in an analysis piece for the Lowy Institute, Australia's former ambassador to China Graham Fletcher noted several wildcards, such as Chinese military action in Taiwan , could still disrupt the "modest new normal" of the relationship.

The change in government at the 2022 federal election acted as a circuit-breaker in increasingly fraught dealings between the nations, although they had still been marred by intimidatory military encounters involving Chinese forces, he said.

China sparked widespread international condemnation over its launch of a ballistic missile into the South Pacific in July following the signing of a landmark mutual defence alliance between Australia and Fiji.

The Albanese government sought to stabilise relations with China after diplomatic tensions peaked during the COVID-19 pandemic under then-prime minister Scott Morrison's leadership.

Your trusted source for staying up-to-date with the world around you. Get free daily news updates and analysis, straight to your inbox.

China slapped $20 billion in trade sanctions on Australian exports, measures that have slowly been wound back.

China is Australia's largest trading partner and is the destination for about a third of the nation's exports.

Fletcher said China had not given up hope of drawing Australia closer into its orbit, while Australia was more focused on consolidating its current relationship.

"But this relationship is unlikely ever to become genuinely close — like the relaxed, intimate fellowship Australia enjoys with like-minded partners elsewhere in its region and beyond," he said.

"The gulf in terms of diverging world views and national security agendas is simply too wide.

"It would be pointless for Canberra to pursue such a goal; it recognises this and is realistic."

The "mismatch" of world views made the relationship vulnerable to disruption, with key risks including another round of serious disagreements or the cataclysm of a conflict, including the use of force against Taiwan.

"An upheaval or conflict is always a possibility, though not in my opinion a strong one at present," the former diplomat said.

Australia would be on firmer ground when facing China if policies had cross-party support and politicians did not "seek to exploit difficulties for domestic advantage", Fletcher said.

"Bipartisanship produces policy consistency and limits China's ability to play games within the Australian system," he said.

title.en: More than one million evacuated, flights cancelled, as Typhoon Dolphin hits China

summary.en: Typhoon Dolphin has led to the evacuation of over one million people and the cancellation of flights in China. The cyclone previously swept across Japan, causing injuries to six people and cutting power to more than 50,000 buildings.
summary.zh: 台风“海豚”袭击中国，导致逾百万人撤离，航班取消。此前，该气旋已横扫日本，造成六人受伤，并导致超过五万栋建筑断电。

body.en:
Typhoon Dolphin brought heavy rain to eastern China on Monday, causing hundreds of flight cancellations even as the storm weakened and some cities resumed public transport.

The typhoon had already swept across Japan’s southern Okinawa prefecture, injuring six people and cutting power to more than 50,000 buildings.

It then made landfall near Yuhuan in eastern Zhejiang province on Sunday evening, China's meteorological authorities said.

The storm packed maximum sustained winds of 151km/h near its centre at landfall, equivalent to a Category 1 hurricane on the Saffir-Simpson scale.

Authorities had moved offshore workers to safety, ordered vessels back to port and increased checks at reservoirs, mountain streams, landslide-prone areas, construction sites and tourist locations.

Your trusted source for staying up-to-date with the world around you. Get free daily news updates and analysis, straight to your inbox.

The weather system lost power after making landfall, with China's National Meteorological Centre (NMC) issuing its least severe typhoon alert on Monday morning.

However, the NMC warned that parts of east and central China would continue to receive heavy rain for the next day.

The typhoon had triggered a top-level alert over the weekend, prompting over 1,000 flight cancellations and tens of thousands of evacuations.

Transport was widely disrupted across the east of the country, and more than one million people were evacuated from their homes.

Nine hundred and forty-three flights from Shanghai's two main passenger airports were cancelled, the airport authority said in an online post.

A 42-year-old tourist from Guangdong said he was stranded in Shanghai after his family's flight, scheduled to depart on Sunday, was cancelled due to Typhoon Dolphin.

He said the family had been rebooked on a flight at 10pm on Monday, although they were unsure whether it would be able to take off.

"To us Guangdong people, this typhoon is as ordinary as having a meal and feeling the wind. It's just part of everyday life," he said, adding that the storm did not appear particularly strong by the standards of China's southern coast.

In neighbouring Zhejiang province, the city of Wenzhou relocated more than 900,000 residents and opened more than 1,000 emergency shelters.

In Fujian province, authorities evacuated 98,900 people from high-risk areas after raising the typhoon emergency response to Level 3, according to Xinhua. Zhejiang, Shanghai and Jiangsu have also activated Level 3 emergency responses.

Fujian maritime authorities said 55 coastal passenger ferry routes had been suspended, all 115 offshore construction projects had been halted, and 290 construction vessels had been moved to sheltered waters.

body.en:
A former high-ranking Catholic known for hosting alcohol-fuelled parties has been convicted of sexually abusing two young Aboriginal men.

Former Bishop of Broome Christopher Alan Saunders, 76, was found guilty of 13 sex offences on Thursday   following a jury trial in the West Australian District Court.

The offending between 2008 and 2019 included one count of sexual penetration without consent and a dozen unlawful and indecent assault charges.

He was acquitted of six other charges, including two counts of indecently dealing with a child over 16 under his authority and four counts of unlawful and indecent assault.

Saunders was ordained as the second Broome bishop in 1996 and presided over 13 schools and nine parishes, before stepping aside in 2020 when the sex abuse claims became public.

Your trusted source for staying up-to-date with the world around you. Get free daily news updates and analysis, straight to your inbox.

Unless acquitted on appeal, Saunders would be the highest-ranking Catholic in Australia convicted of sexual abuse while a member of the clergy.

The late Cardinal George Pell was found guilty in 2018 but later acquitted by the High Court of raping one choirboy and molesting another in 1996.

Prosecutors said Saunders, known as Brother B by his victims, put on alcohol-fuelled parties at Catholic Church-owned properties to get access to Aboriginal boys and men so he could sexually assault them.

"The accused had a sexual interest in young Aboriginal men and a tendency to act on that interest when the opportunity presented itself," prosecutor Adam Ebell said.

Saunders, who studied law before becoming the first diocesan priest ordained in WA's Kimberley region in 1976, exploited the power imbalance between himself and the younger men, he said.

The main complainant, who cannot be named for legal reasons, said he was aged 16 when the then-bishop started grooming him at a Broome home in regular visits during which he was given alcohol.

The interactions over the decade that followed involved kissing, naked wrestling, touching of private areas and penetrative sex, he said.

His lawyer Tony Hager attacked the three complainants, saying they were convicted criminals with long records who had abused alcohol and drugs during their lives, which impacted their memories.

Saunders was initially on trial for 30 sexual assault charges, but four charges related to a child under the age of 13 were removed from the prosecution on the first day of proceedings.

He was acquitted of a further seven charges mid-trial due to insufficient evidence being presented to the jury.

title.en: 130,000 people: One Nation clarifies plan for major migration cut

summary.en: A key detail behind One Nation's headline migration pledge has now come into focus.

body.en:
One Nation has confirmed its plan to significantly limit migration to Australia to 130,000 people a year will be based on the net overseas migration forecast.

Australia's migration level has become one of the most combustible debates in federal politics, as the nation faces a housing shortage and pressure on services, particularly in suburban areas.

Migration experts have warned of the dangers of political parties attempting to blame migrants for a lack of homes , arguing that migrant workforces will be essential to building the required housing stock .

The net overseas migration measure is forecast by projecting how many people will enter and depart the country; it includes returning Australians.

This measure includes visitor and tourist options, family and partner visas, working holidaymakers, skilled migration, plus refugee and humanitarian programs.

Your trusted source for staying up-to-date with the world around you. Get free daily news updates and analysis, straight to your inbox.

Under Labor, net overseas migration reached a record high of 556,000 in 2023, following the COVID-19 pandemic.

But Labor has moved to tighten restrictions, projecting net overseas migration to fall to 225,000 people by the 2027-2028 financial year.

The government is preparing to unveil a plan to wind back migration settings to ensure the net overseas migration forecast is met.

Home Affairs Minister Tony Burke was set to unveil that plan at the National Press Club last week — but it was put on hold after cabinet jitters about the political implications of cuts to certain programs.

According to its website, One Nation's policy is "capping visas at 130,000 per year to ease pressure on housing, wages, and infrastructure".

A One Nation spokesperson has confirmed to SBS World News that the cap of 130,000 will be on net overseas migration.

That is a dramatic reduction from the current numbers, which the government maintains would affect a range of visa categories and impede productivity nationwide.

But One Nation leader Pauline Hanson maintains the government has been too reliant on migration to keep the economy going.

Meanwhile, Nationals and senior Liberals have distanced themselves from a figure the Opposition's housing minister suggested cutting immigration to.

Andrew Bragg used a National Press Club speech on Wednesday to argue for a Coalition policy of capping net overseas migration at 180,000.

But Nationals leader Matt Canavan has already cautioned against any moves that would reduce the workforce in regional areas.

On Thursday, Opposition leader Angus Taylor said Bragg was expressing personal views and didn't run the speech by him before he delivered it.

summary.en: Australia's next total solar eclipse will deliver a rare spectacle across parts of the country.
summary.zh: 这是一则来自澳洲栏目的新闻，重点涉及和平与克制。如需完整细节，请阅读英文原始报道。

body.en:
As millions turned out to see the total solar eclipse over Europe, some Australians may be wondering when it will be our turn to enjoy such a spectacle.

If you're among them, there's some good news: Australia's next total solar eclipse is on the horizon, and it will bring a rare celestial spectacle to parts of the country.

A total solar eclipse is when the moon's orbit passes between the Earth and the sun. For a few moments, the three planetary bodies align. The moon almost perfectly blocks the sun from view, plunging the planet below into a brief darkness.

That's quite different to the partial solar eclipse. In a partial solar eclipse, the orbits of the Earth, moon, and sun align, but the moon only obscures part of the sun.

Your trusted source for staying up-to-date with the world around you. Get free daily news updates and analysis, straight to your inbox.

It's rare for total solar eclipses to happen anywhere. It's rarer still for them to happen in Australia. There have been just five total solar eclipses visible from Australia in the last 50 years — two close together in 1974 and 1976, then long gaps between eclipses in 2002, 2013 and 2023.

Even then, the word "visible" has done some heavy lifting. Most total eclipses only graze the Australian continent, passing over a northern or southern tip. The 2023 total eclipse, for instance, passed just off the North West Cape region of Western Australia and then transited northeast over Indonesia and Papua New Guinea.

The 2028 total solar eclipse, also referred to as the Great Australasian Eclipse in some quarters, will start on Saturday 22 July 2028. As the name suggests, the moon will completely obscure the sun for those on the ground.

It will pass south-west across the Australian continent from the Kimberley in northern Western Australia. The eclipse path will then move across the Northern Territory, south-western Queensland and rural NSW, and finally arrive directly over Sydney.

For those in the Kimberley, the total eclipse will begin at around 11am AWST. In Sydney, the total eclipse will start at 2pm AEST. It will last for around four minutes as the moon passes in front of the sun.

To put the rarity of an eclipse path of this kind into context, 2028 will be the first time Sydney has experienced a total solar eclipse since 1857. According to NASA, it won't happen again for another 800 years — 3 June 2858.

When the 2028 eclipse passes over Dunedin in New Zealand later that afternoon, it will be the first to do so since 1163.

But what about Australian cities other than Sydney? Will you be able to see the eclipse?

body.en:
The Coalition's plan to boost housing stock will involve "trade-offs", a Liberal frontbencher has said, after suggesting low-income households should accept living in substandard homes.

Opposition housing and homelessness spokesperson Andrew Bragg announced on Wednesday that the Opposition would reduce the national housing code from 2,000 pages to 80 if elected.

When asked by ABC Radio National on Thursday morning whether his policy means low-income earners should just accept living in substandard housing, he replied: "Yes, definitely."

He went on to say that building more homes under a streamlined code would come with "trade-offs".

title.en: 'Beautiful day': Whistleblower David McBride released from prison after successful parole bid
title.zh: “美好的一天”：举报人大卫·麦克布莱德成功假释出狱

summary.en: Former Australian Army lawyer David McBride has been released from prison after a successful parole bid. He was sentenced to a maximum of five years and eight months in jail in May 2024.
summary.zh: 前澳大利亚陆军律师大卫·麦克布莱德在成功申请假释后获释。他于2024年5月被判处最高五年零八个月的监禁。

body.en:
Whistleblower David McBride has avoided political questions on the day of his release from prison, instead making a quick getaway to see his beloved dog.

The 62-year-old was released after more than two years behind bars following a successful parole bid.

"I'm very happy to be out. It's a beautiful day to be free," he said, speaking to media from a car on his way out of Canberra's Alexander Maconochie Centre on Thursday.

The former army lawyer was sentenced to a maximum of five years and eight months in jail in May 2024 after he helped steal secret defence documents about the Afghanistan war. He then leaked them to the media.

His parole was considered and granted on Thursday morning, a spokesperson for Attorney-General Michelle Rowland said.

"The government does not provide specific commentary or details about individual parole matters," the spokesperson said.

The former army lawyer was sentenced to a maximum of five years and eight months in jail in May 2024 after he helped steal secret defence documents about the Afghanistan war. He then leaked them to the press.

McBride served his full non-parole period of 27 months and was granted release on the same morning he became eligible.

McBride had been "brave" in blowing the whistle on war crimes, Whistleblower Justice Fund founder and former senator Rex Patrick said.

"It's so good to see the end of an awful saga that should never have happened. I salute David, who walks away from prison with his head held high," he said.

McBride had aimed to expose excessive investigation of Australian soldiers in Afghanistan, but it was revealed soon after that defence personnel had been involved in illegal killings while on the front lines. He pleaded guilty to three charges, including theft.

"I'm looking forward to seeing my dog and my daughters ... hopefully my dog will remember who I am," he said upon release.

He declined to answer questions about Australia's whistleblower laws, saying he wanted to be fair to Rowland, who had just approved his parole.

McBride will be allowed to serve the last three years of his sentence in the community under supervision and strict conditions.

The news was celebrated by Greens senator David Shoebridge, who said McBride should have walked free long ago.

"My friend David McBride has paid a terrible price for saying the truth. It's a price no whistleblower should ever be made to pay again," Shoebridge said in a statement.

An ACT government spokesperson said the territory's corrective services would continue to perform its statutory functions, which included monitoring McBride when he was in community.
